changes.summary: Added the FAA administrator's testimony that the arch received a standard obstruction review but that the review did not contemplate Trump's later drone-operations proposal.
Added Reuters' bounded measurement of the September noncitizen-voting prosecution surge while preserving the distinction among charges, convictions, ballots and election effects.
Added the District of Columbia court's second vacatur of EPA's program-wide Solar for All termination premise without inferring grant payment or implementation.
Added the White House and energy secretary's public disavowal of a flat diesel-export ban while preserving narrower discussions as non-operative proposals.
